title: Velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly derives v = qBR/m from equating magnetic Lorentz force to centripetal force.

title: Exit point distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates s = 0.8R for beam c using Pythagorean theorem on the circular trajectory geometry.

title: Maximum plate distance
description: Essential: Correctly determines L_max = 4R/15 from geometric constraints ensuring all three beams hit the plate.

title: Force-piecewise derivation
description: Important: Applies impulse-momentum theorem correctly to relate average force F to change in vertical momentum of absorbed ions.

title: Beam geometry analysis
description: Important: Correctly identifies which beams hit the plate for different L ranges (0<L<4R/15, 4R/15<L<0.4R, L>0.4R).

title: Vertical momentum component
description: Important: Correctly computes the vertical component of momentum for ions in beams a and c as p_z = 0.8qBR using trigonometry.

title: Trajectory radius recognition
description: Optional: Explicitly notes that all ions have the same radius R in the magnetic field due to equal v, q, m, B.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for force direction (e.g., positive instead of negative for downward plate force) or misassigns momentum changes.

title: Geometry miscalculation
description: Pitfall: Makes arithmetic or geometric errors in Pythagorean calculations (e.g., s ≠ 0.8R) or in similar triangle ratios for L_max.

title: Beam counting mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly counts the number of beams contributing to the force in each L range (e.g., omits beam a or c when it should be included).
